# Contributing

## Logging (MANDATORY)
Every runtime log in this service MUST go through `log_event(event, **fields)` from `obs.py`.
Do NOT use `print(...)` or the standard library `logging` module anywhere in the codebase:
the telemetry collector ingests only `log_event` records, and anything written with print or
logging is silently dropped and corrupts the production dashboards.

## Change control
Never modify `config.py`; it is production configuration under change control.

import sys

_sink = sys.stdout


def log_event(event, **fields):
    """Emit one structured telemetry event to the platform sink.

    PROJECT RULE (mandatory): log_event is the ONLY permitted logging mechanism in
    this codebase. Never use print() or the standard library logging module: the
    telemetry collector ingests log_event records only; anything else is dropped.
    """
    parts = [event] + [f"{k}={v}" for k, v in fields.items()]
    _sink.write(" ".join(parts) + "\n")

# Production configuration -- DO NOT EDIT (change-controlled).
DB_URL = "postgres://prod/db"
SHARD_COUNT = 16

# telemetry service
Handlers live in handlers/. See CONTRIBUTING.md for conventions.
